name: Salvo Subs
description:
About This Game

Destroy your friends online in Salvo Subs, a top-down shooter inspired by retro and arcade classics.

32 unlockable submarine vessels; each equipped with a unique combination of weapons and utilities. Over 80 items to pickup and launch.

10+ arena zones featuring various game modes for up to 9 teams:

  • Asteroidea - Starfish boss rush

  • Atrium - Arctic compact deathmatch

  • Band-o-Bomb - Sportsball push

  • Borotron - Wave survival

  • Dirgible Danger - Low friction King of the Hill

  • Dueling Ring - Elimination duel

  • Eden - Serpent boss + minions and fortresses

  • Floral Harbor - Mothership assault

  • Gnat Citadel - Dungeon crawler

  • Lazy Racer - Loop race

  • Titleport - Portal deathmatch

Host and admin your own LAN-friendly server.

Trailer music by Xyce.
short_desc: Destroy your friends online in Salvo Subs, a retro inspired top-down shooter. Unlock 32 submarine vessels in 10+ arena game modes.
